svg.title: Generic assays — Mutational Signature Contribution Scores (COSMIC v2) — Melanoma vs Non-small cell lung
svg.text: 30 Mutational Signature Contribution Scores (COSMIC v2) entities tested (Welch's t-test) · 27 at q < 0.05
difference in mean (Melanoma − Non-small cell lung)
3 of 12 entities named on this volcano could not be labelled without overprinting another
label or point and are left unlabelled: Signature8 (Unknown), Signature15 (MMR),
+12 more entities tested (the full table is in the result and the MCP text)
Every entity of “Mutational Signature Contribution Scores (COSMIC v2)” (mutational_signatures_contribution_v2) compared across the cohorts, one value per sample as
the study recorded it, from each cohort's own samples. Values that are not numbers (a limit such as ">8", or NA) are left out (0 of them). Each entity is tested with Welch's
t-test from each cohort's n, mean and variance; with thousands of samples a tiny difference is significant, so read the means too. 30 entities tested; q is
Benjamini–Hochberg across all of them. 0 were not tested: fewer than 3 samples with a value in some cohort, or no spread.
